comparison.objective: Measure two level scoops of powder into a bottle, not commission a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Scooping, strike-off, narrow-neck pouring, and spill avoidance; no tool insertion, locking, or impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: 16.6–19.1 g delivered after bar-leveling, with under 1 g spilled, versus repeatable safe carriage stops.
comparison.reason: The objective, manipulation, and irreversible error modes are unrelated.
